ModMetaData.name: Totally Working: Fake Code Overlay
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Warning: this mod was written with AI coding tools (Claude Code).
A boss key: press it to cover the game with a see-through black screen of scrolling code, so from a distance it looks like you are working. The game keeps running underneath and stays fully playable. Game windows such as the architect menu are covered too (can be switched off), and clicks still reach them.
The code is put together while you play from the game and your loaded mods: class outlines built from their names, mixed with snippets of their XML files. It comes out in bursts with random pauses, like a build console, and stops while the game is paused so the latest game events stay on screen. Nothing from the game is copied into this mod.
Game events show up in the code too: new letters as // TODO comments and messages as // NOTE comments, in the game's colours, and log errors and warnings as red and yellow compiler errors. Live colony status is logged as well: alerts, colonist state changes (downed, mental breaks, drafting, injuries), optional job changes and an hourly colony summary. Events that happen together are merged into one line.
A log-only option (off by default) drops the fake code and shows just the events, as a live colony log.
Usage - F9 switches the overlay between light and heavy, Shift + F9 turns it off. The key can be changed under Options, Keyboard. - Ctrl + mouse wheel makes the current level darker or lighter; the code fades along with the black screen. - While the overlay is on, the window title and icon change to Notepad's (Windows only; the title can be changed in the mod settings). - Scroll the mouse wheel up to read back; the game still zooms as usual, and the view returns to the newest lines after 5 seconds. - Names of every pawn are shown on top of the overlay where they stand, coloured by who they are (can be switched off in the mod settings). - Darkness of each level, scroll speed, text size and which events to show are in the mod settings.
Notes - Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. - Please do not use this at work. It is a joke mod: anyone who takes a closer look will see through it, and the author takes no responsibility for what happens if your boss does.
